benchmark_name: UN-SPIDER vs BHU LOKA Urban SAR Comparison

bhu_loka_algorithm.principle: Bimodal Inundation Physics (Specular Drop + Urban Dihedral Corner Double-Bounce)

scientific_findings.physical_root_cause: Urban street canyons (Rajendra Nagar, Kankarbagh) act as 90-degree corner reflectors with building facades, increasing SAR backscatter (+1.5 to +8.0 dB) rather than decreasing it. Naive UN-SPIDER thresholds fail in dense built-up cities.
